verdict.rationale: Carta publishes developer docs, so agent-readable docs are a fair axis to judge it on. Probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown docs variant (404) and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path (404). The Claude MCP plugin setup guides describe connecting agents to Carta data, not docs formatted for agents to read, so they are credited to the separate MCP story rather than this one.
